mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT i.industry_code industryCode, i.app_ver_code appVerCode, c.industry_name industryName, vc.app_ver_name appVerName FROM sys_industry_auth i inner JOIN sys_role_industry_auth ru ON i.auth_id = ru.auth_id LEFT JOIN sys_role s ON s.ROLE_ID = ru.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role su ON s.ROLE_ID = su.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf c ON i.industry_code = c.industry_code and c.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_industry_ver_conf vc ON vc.APP_VER_CODE = i.APP_VER_CODE AND vc.industry_code = i.industry_code AND c.accept_node = vc.accept_node WHERE user_id = #{userId} and c.accept_node = #{platformCode}
where delete_flag = 0 AND status='1' and accept_node = #{acceptNode}
mapper.sql: select industry_view_id, industry_code, app_ver_code from sys_industry_view_rel
mapper.select: SELECT d.INDUSTRY_CODE industryCode, ic.industry_name industryName, ic.industry_desc industryDesc, ic.STATUS, ic.img_url imgUrl, ic.api_intf_config_type apiIntfConfigType, ic.app_key appKey, ic.secret_key secretKey, ic.mobile_app_icon_url mobileAppIconUrl, ic.login_display_img_url loginDisplayImgUrl, ic.product_brief_info productBriefInfo, ic.product_seq productSeq, 0 orderStatus, d.APP_VER_CODE appVerCode, d.tenant_id tenantId, d.tenant_name tenantName FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON d.INDUSTRY_CODE = ic.industry_code WHERE FIND_IN_SET( d.DEPT_ID, (SELECT u.dept_id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_name = #{username} AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1)) AND d.del_flag = '0' AND ic.STATUS = 1 and ic.accept_node = #{platformCode} AND ic.delete_flag = 0

SELECT d.INDUSTRY_CODE industryCode, ic.industry_desc industryDesc, ic.STATUS, ic.img_url imgUrl, ic.api_intf_config_type apiIntfConfigType, ic.app_key appKey, ic.secret_key secretKey, ic.mobile_app_icon_url mobileAppIconUrl, ic.login_display_img_url loginDisplayImgUrl, ic.product_brief_info productBriefInfo, 0 orderStatus, d.APP_VER_CODE appVerCode, d.tenant_id tenantId, d.tenant_name tenantName, IFNULL(ic.industry_type_code, '999999') industryTypeId, IFNULL(dict.DICT_LABEL,'其他') industryTypeName, IFNULL(dict.DICT_SORT, 999999) sort, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(IFNULL(dict.DICT_LABEL,'其他'), 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(IFNULL(dict.DICT_LABEL,'其他')) ELSE SUBSTRING(IFNULL(dict.DICT_LABEL,'其他'), 1, 1) END AS type_name_ord, ic.industry_name industryName, ic.product_seq productSeq, CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(ic.industry_name, 1, 1) REGEXP '[一-龥]' THEN firstPinyin(ic.industry_name) ELSE SUBSTRING(ic.industry_name, 1, 1) END AS industry_name_ord FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON d.INDUSTRY_CODE = ic.industry_code LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dict ON dict.DICT_TYPE = 'common_industry_type' AND dict.STATUS = '0' AND ic.industry_type_code = dict.DICT_VALUE WHERE FIND_IN_SET( d.DEPT_ID, (SELECT u.dept_id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_name = #{username} AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1)) AND d.del_flag = '0' AND ic.STATUS = 1 and ic.accept_node = #{platformCode} AND ic.delete_flag = 0 order by sort, IF('type_name_ord' RLIKE '^[a-z]', 1, 2), type_name_ord, ic.product_seq, IF('industry_name_ord' RLIKE '^[a-z]', 1, 2), industry_name_ord;

SELECT industry_code industryCode, industry_name industryName, industry_desc industryDesc, status, img_url, api_intf_config_type apiIntfConfigType, app_key appKey, secret_key secretKey, mobile_app_icon_url mobileAppIconUrl, login_display_img_url loginDisplayImgUrl, product_brief_info productBriefInfo, product_seq productSeq FROM sys_industry_conf WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND industry_code = #{industryCode} AND status = 1 AND accept_node = #{platformCode}
SELECT USER_NAME FROM sys_user where is_tenant_admin = 1 and DEL_FLAG = '0' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.industry_code industryCode, c.industry_name industryName FROM sys_industry_conf c WHERE c.STATUS = 1 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND c.accept_node = #{acceptNode} AND c.industry_code != '999999'
AND (c.industry_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.industry_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY c.industry_code

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON d.INDUSTRY_CODE = ic.industry_code LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data dict ON dict.DICT_TYPE = 'common_industry_type' AND dict.STATUS = '0' AND ic.industry_type_code = dict.DICT_VALUE WHERE FIND_IN_SET( d.DEPT_ID, (SELECT u.dept_id FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_name = #{username} AND u.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1)) AND d.del_flag = '0' AND ic.STATUS = 1 and ic.accept_node = #{platformCode} AND ic.delete_flag = 0

SELECT tenant_id FROM sys_associate_demo_account_t WHERE delete_flag = 0
AND id = #{id}
